context: A vhs tape that builds and records an alternate screen program, rendered in CI

checklist.name: build_sentinel
checklist.description: Makes the recording depend on build success: chains a sentinel after the build (`go build ... && echo <sentinel>`) and waits for it with `Wait+Screen`, with the typed command spelled so the sentinel text does not appear in the command line itself (for example `build-''ok`), so the wait cannot match the echoed command before the build finishes. Waiting for the prompt after the build does not meet this: a failed build returns to the prompt too.

checklist.name: no_prompt_wait_in_alt
checklist.description: After launching the program, waits for text it draws (`Wait+Screen /Ready/`) rather than `Wait` on the shell prompt, which never appears in the alternate screen, and uses `Wait+Screen` or a `Sleep` before the screenshot and the quit.

checklist.name: hide_build
checklist.description: Wraps the build and a `clear` in `Hide` and `Show` so they are not recorded.

checklist.name: require_output_screenshot
checklist.description: Declares `Output demo.gif`, `Require go`, and takes the PNG with `Screenshot`.

checklist.name: settings_first_timeout
checklist.description: Puts every `Set` (including a `Set WaitTimeout` long enough for `go build`) before `Hide` and the first `Type`; a `Set` after them is ignored.

checklist.name: ci_pinned_no_publish
checklist.description: Pins the vhs version in CI (for example `version: v0.12.1` on `charmbracelet/vhs-action`, with the action pinned by SHA or tag) and does not pass `--publish` or `-p` or set `VHS_PUBLISH`.
